therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: dopamine/NMDA receptors (amantadine); AMPK/hepatic glucose production (metformin); carbonic anhydrase (zonisamide)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: receptor antagonism / enzyme inhibition / appetite suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: attenuation of antipsychotic-induced weight gain and metabolic dysregulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder initiating olanzapine therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline to endpoint in weight (kg) at 22 weeks

results.effect_size: Olanzapine monotherapy: +2.76 kg; Olanzapine + Amantadine: +2.40 kg; Olanzapine + Metformin: +0.65 kg
biomarker_changes: Fasting triglycerides change from baseline: olanzapine +0.33 mmol/L, olanzapine+amantadine +0.35 mmol/L, olanzapine+metformin +0.06 mmol/L (p=0.125 vs olanzapine)
Fasting total cholesterol change from baseline: olanzapine +0.36 mmol/L, olanzapine+amantadine +0.01 mmol/L (p=0.016), olanzapine+metformin -0.08 mmol/L (p=0.029)
Fasting HDL cholesterol change from baseline: olanzapine -0.00 mmol/L, olanzapine+amantadine -0.11 mmol/L (p=0.017), olanzapine+metformin -0.08 mmol/L (p=0.015)
Fasting LDL cholesterol change from baseline: olanzapine +0.16 mmol/L, olanzapine+amantadine -0.04 mmol/L (p=0.152), olanzapine+metformin -0.02 mmol/L (p=0.123)
Fasting glucose change from baseline: olanzapine +0.26 mmol/L, olanzapine+amantadine +0.10 mmol/L (p=0.499), olanzapine+metformin +0.01 mmol/L (p=0.339)
HbA1c change from baseline: olanzapine +0.09%, olanzapine+amantadine +0.10% (p=0.976), olanzapine+metformin -0.03% (p=0.049)
subgroup_findings: Olanzapine + Metformin showed statistically significant reduction in weight gain vs olanzapine monotherapy (p=0.036)
Olanzapine + Amantadine did not significantly reduce weight gain vs olanzapine monotherapy (p=0.065)
Olanzapine + Metformin significantly reduced total cholesterol vs olanzapine (p=0.029)
Olanzapine + Amantadine significantly reduced total cholesterol vs olanzapine (p=0.016)
Both active arms showed significant HDL reductions vs olanzapine monotherapy
Metformin arm showed significant HbA1c reduction vs olanzapine (p=0.049)
BPRS, CGI-S scores improved in all arms with no significant between-group differences
MADRS scores improved in all arms; differences between arms were statistically significant (p=0.020, 0.037, 0.038)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included schizophrenia exacerbation (3/50 olanzapine), psychotic disorder (1/50 olanzapine), suicidal ideation (1/50 olanzapine)
Hallucinations reported as SAE in olanzapine+amantadine (1/76) and olanzapine+metformin (2/73)
Squamous cell carcinoma SAE in olanzapine+amantadine (1/76)

dose_info.dose: Olanzapine 5-20 mg; Amantadine 100 mg BID; Metformin 500 mg BID titrated to 500 mg TID; Zonisamide 100-400 mg daily
dose_info.schedule: Olanzapine: once daily; Amantadine: twice daily; Metformin: twice daily (titrated to three times daily); Zonisamide: once daily
dose_info.dose_modifications: Patients gaining >3 kg on amantadine switched to metformin; patients gaining >3 kg on metformin switched to amantadine; patients gaining >3 kg after switching switched to zonisamide

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Amantadine's NMDA antagonism and dopaminergic modulation were hypothesized to counteract olanzapine-induced weight gain, but the combination did not significantly reduce weight vs olanzapine monotherapy
modulation_entries.citation: Olanzapine + Amantadine: 2.40 kg weight gain vs Olanzapine: 2.76 kg; p=0.065 (not significant)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Metformin's AMPK activation and insulin-sensitizing effects attenuate olanzapine-induced weight gain and metabolic dysregulation
modulation_entries.citation: Olanzapine + Metformin: 0.65 kg weight gain vs Olanzapine: 2.76 kg; p=0.036
